## About
Ly Auto Repair & Mobile Service is based on E Huntington Dr in Tempe. Instead of you bringing the car to a shop, we bring the repair to you, whether that's your driveway or the side of the road.
We focus on finding the real problem before replacing parts. A reviewer said other mechanics tried to sell her a starter, and Ly told her she just needed a battery. Another wrote that the owner is very patient in explaining what's wrong with the car.
Ly Auto Repair is rated 5 from 50 Google reviews. Call or send a message with your vehicle details and we'll get back to you.

## Services
- Check engine light diagnostics: Tracking down why the light is on so you know what actually needs fixing.
- Light engine repair and preventative maintenance: Smaller engine repairs and regular upkeep, done where your car is parked.
- AC recharge: Recharging your car's air conditioning. (Starting at $150)
- Roadside assistance: Fuel refill and lockout help, with a service call within 50 miles of Tempe. ($100 service call)

## FAQ
Q: Do I need to bring my car in?
A: No. This is a mobile auto repair service, so we come to you.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Send your vehicle's year, make, model and engine size, or the VIN, and we'll work up an estimate.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Our hours are listed as open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday. Call or send a message to set up a time.
